captured_from: claude --version reported 2.1.288 (Claude Code) on the machine this fixture was written on. Read from that build's bundled hook dispatcher: SessionStart input carries hook_event_name SessionStart plus source, agent_type, model and session_title, and its hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext is injected into model context. Stop input carries hook_event_name Stop, stop_hook_active and last_assistant_message; a Stop response with decision block keeps the turn going with reason as the model-visible feedback, and the harness itself overrides after CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP (default 8) consecutive blocks, which is above our cap of 3. SessionEnd input carries hook_event_name SessionEnd and reason; SessionEnd output is not read by the model, so the hook prints nothing. SessionEnd hooks run under CLAUDE_CODE_SESSIONEND_HOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS, otherwise the larger of a short built-in bound and the configured hook timeout, so the 10 s install timeout is the effective bound.
